That sounds exhausting — not just the crying, but the immediate second job of scanning the room while your hands keep typing. The car was private; the desk is public, so part of your brain turns into a security camera: *who walked past, what did they see, is Debbie about to come over.*

“Kept typing” makes sense as a shield. It’s the office version of looking busy so no one asks.

Did Debbie actually come over — or did the waiting end up being worse than the asking?
